title: Fix 314 folders
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-records-015 already says the migration neither reads, lists nor removes a file or folder whose name starts with ._; only the folder clean-up and its test change.
acceptance_criteria: A 0.5.x project with a ._* folder holding only an empty folder under .chough/history/ previews with the same plan digest as without it, and after the apply that ._* folder and the folder inside it are both still there; the migration neither descends into nor removes a folder whose name starts with ._.

answers.constraints: The specs/cli/cli.3md lesson on native tasks applies: human gates are listed as plain text in tasks.md, not as checkboxes. No other lesson or principle constrains it.
